Gate mission: Cleared Tunnel Slime Nest inside Sunken Courtyard (swamp; hazard: toxic spores) in cloudy weather (roll 98 vs 51) for ¥5,400 and 10 rank points; gained 2 ability exposure; fare cost ¥240.
